8	function bench(name, ...args) {
9		console.log(`\n# ${name}`);
10		new Suite()
11			.add('classcat ≠  ', () => classcat.apply(classcat, [args]))

15			.add('clsx (lite) ', () => lite.apply(lite, args))
16			.on('cycle', e => console.log('  ' + e.target))
17			.run();
18	}
